meta.provenance: Captured from the real services/progressService.js and services/mistakesService.js by running them against a recording Firestore double. Only React Native infrastructure (Firestore, auth, AsyncStorage) is mocked; no service logic is stubbed. These fixtures are never hand-written to match a port.

cases.description: Free sample exam, no prior history. Denominator is max(10, attempted), never the 20 served.
Free sample exam with 4 attempted: the locked floor holds the denominator at 10.
Sample exam beating a prior sample attempt: best score/total pair moves to the new attempt.
Sample exam worse than the prior best: the retained best keeps its OWN matched denominator.
Paid full-bank exam, no prior. Full scope stores served as the denominator and feeds the Prepometer.
Full exam on a chapter carrying sample history: the sample fields must survive the lastExam* takeover.
Legacy unmarked 30-question doc classifies as FULL, so previousExam* carry the legacy attempt.
Legacy unmarked 20-question doc classifies as SAMPLE and normalizes its served-count denominator on read.
Wrong answers join the deck; a correct answer on an active deck question advances its streak to the retire threshold.
Practice run with no prior: practiceAttempted increments and exam fields are never touched.
Practice on a chapter with existing practice and sample history: the increment is additive, history untouched.
A mistakes-deck re-attempt: session source is 'mistakes', and correct answers advance deck streaks.
Flashcard self-grades: one sessions doc only. Never touches chapterProgress, the Prepometer, or the mistakes deck.
A run with no grades writes nothing at all.
